tagline: Raised sides to lean into, in a houndstooth you'll want in the living room.
lead: Your dog gets raised, cushioned sides to lean into, and a bed smart enough to stay in the living room with you.
value: A bed you like the look of stays in the room where your dog wants to be, not out in the hall.
intro: Magpie is a bolster dog bed with a classic houndstooth exterior, raised cushioned sides, soft fibre filling and a removable, washable cover. Four sizes, Small to XL.
points: A cushioned edge around the resting area to rest a chin against.
Yielding rather than firm. If your dog needs firm support, choose a memory foam bed.
A pattern that belongs in a living room rather than a utility room.
It comes off for cleaning, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Dogs who like an edge to lean on, in homes where the bed sits in a room you have decorated.
fit_note: The raised sides take up part of the outside size, so measure your dog curled up as well as stretched out. Ask us for exact measurements, or which of the four sizes to take.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Houndstooth Dog Bed with Raised Sides | Snoozly
seo_description: A houndstooth dog bed with raised, cushioned sides to lean on, smart enough for the living room. Soft fibre filling, removable washable cover, Small to XL.
